projectDescription: A file-based state system for AI agents that externalizes identity, memory, tasks, and context into structured versioned markdown files so agents persist across sessions.
keyFeatures: Structured markdown templates externalizing AI agent state (identity, memory, tasks, context) into versioned files
Three-class ontology: State (current truth), History (append-only), Library (curated knowledge)
Four deployment tiers: Minimum, Standard, Full, Advanced — start small, grow only as needed
State Packs for 9 agent roles: developer, backend, frontend, researcher, judge, security, ops, orchestrator, docs-writer
Nesting model with parent-child scope resolution — any file nests into project subdirectories
Mesh: many-to-many edges between state files and nested directories so one entry serves multiple files
Runtime adapters for Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Hermes, OpenClaw, Agent Zero
Git integration: every commit is a verifiable cognitive snapshot
Optional hooks for automating state-file reactions (webhooks, event logs, task moves)
BINDING.schema.json for machine-readable agent contracts in recursive multi-agent systems
publicApiSurface: AGENTS.md — bootloader, load order, runtime params, project guard
STATE.md — current operational truth (overwrite in place)
SNAPSHOT.md — last known good state / restoration anchor
WARNING.md — hard limits and pre-action checklists
CHECKPOINT.md — approval gate before irreversible actions
BINDING.schema.json — machine-readable binding contract for recursive agents
SOUL.md / SELF.md / IDENTITY.md — three-surface identity model
